name: Boulderslide Ravine
summary: Along Webwinder Path, Boulderslide Ravine cuts through the central peaks of the Stonetalon Mountains. Horde and Alliance fighting rarely reaches this quiet pass. Rocky slopes lead toward Boulderslide Cavern, while wild mountain beasts roam the heights.

sections.title: A Quiet Mountain Pass
sections.body: Boulderslide Ravine is a narrow pass leading to a subterranean lair deep in the mountains. Loggers, night elves, and the Horde fight over timber and sacred glades elsewhere in the region, but soldiers rarely enter this narrow pass. Mountain rams and crag beasts roam its ledges and sheer walls. Cliff Stormers are among them. Prospectors watch the slopes for rich mineral veins on the way toward the deeper cavern network.

sections.title: Traces in the Stone
sections.body: Across from Boulderslide Cavern's entrance, a small cave looks over the ravine. Rough torches light weathered supply barrels and primitive tribal paintings. The designs resemble ancient tauren art. They suggest native tribes once traveled through these crags or took shelter here, long before modern conflict reached the mountains.

aliases: how to get to boulderslide ravine
faq.answer: Boulderslide Ravine lies in the Stonetalon Mountains. Follow Webwinder Path into the higher crags to reach it.
Mountain rams and crag beasts inhabit Boulderslide Ravine. Cliff Stormers are among the dangerous crag beasts found there.

faq.q: What is the abandoned cave across from Boulderslide Cavern?
faq.answer: Across from Boulderslide Cavern's entrance, a small cave holds old barrels and burns with torchlight. Tribal paintings cover its stone walls and resemble tauren art. They suggest local wanderers or hunters once used the shelter.
Boulderslide Ravine leads toward Boulderslide Cavern, a subterranean lair deep in the mountains. Its slopes also offer valuable mineral outcroppings to travelers passing through.

angles.text: As a miner, look for veins exposed along the ravine's steep walls as the mountain stone shifts.
As a tauren, you may recognize the faded tribal designs in the small side cave. They hint at ancestral paths through the Stonetalon heights.
